description: Manual switch, 4HP, sending one of four inputs to a single output

params.text: Each press moves to the next input, stepping through the four in turn and wrapping back to the first

inputs.text: Passed to the OUT jack while the first of the four positions is picked
Passed to the OUT jack while the second of the four positions is picked
Passed to the OUT jack while the third of the four positions is picked
Passed to the OUT jack while the fourth of the four positions is picked

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the four inputs the SELECT button has picked

notes: one channel only; a polyphonic cable at an input passes its first channel and drops the rest
